description: Source code for the ProximitySensor class implementation, handling proximity sensor data reading, enabling/disabling, and event processing for Android devices.

classes.name: ProximitySensor
classes.description: Class managing proximity sensor interactions, including enabling/disabling, reading events, and converting sensor data.

methods.name: ProximitySensor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the proximity sensor object, setting default values, and enabling the sensor if data_fd is valid.

methods.name: ~ProximitySensor
methods.description: Destructor disabling the sensor if it is enabled.

methods.name: setInitialState
methods.description: Reads the initial proximity value and sets the pending event accordingly.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the proximity sensor by writing to sysfs and updating internal state.

methods.name: hasPendingEvents
methods.description: Returns whether there are pending proximity events.

methods.name: readEvents
methods.description: Reads proximity sensor events, processes input events, and populates the data buffer.

methods.name: indexToValue
methods.description: Converts a sensor index to a proximity distance value.
